messages:
maya (Design): Pushed a new compact rules table mock to the preview: https://internal.redwood.dev/preview/rules-compact-4

ben (Product): Looking good. Does compact mode remove the description column or just collapse it behind an expand affordance?

maya (Design): It collapses descriptions under an inline chevron; the main table only shows key fields.

sam (Eng): Reorder handles on mobile still tiny. Can we increase touch targets?

maya (Design): Yep — expanded hit target to 14px and added keyboard reorder: Ctrl+Alt+Up / Ctrl+Alt+Down.

elaine (A11y): Please include those shortcuts in the accessibility help modal and as a tooltip on the drag handle. Also add aria-grabbed and a focus ring on handle focus.

ben (Product): Saw a flaky "Order conflict" toast when saving changes, even though backend saved. Might be client-side optimistic update race.

sam (Eng): I'll debounce the assign-priority RPC by 400ms and only surface toasts for real errors.

maya (Design): The preview simulator shows lower match counts for some prefix routes. @ben any known caching problems?

ben (Product): Yes, simulator cache wasn't invalidating on edits. I'll patch it to clear when rules change.

design-bot: Image uploaded: compact-v4.png

elaine (A11y): Contrast issue: small priority pill text drops under AA at 13px. Suggest reversed pill for top tiers or slightly heavier weight.

maya (Design): I'll mock reversed pills for priorities 1-3 and a bolder font weight.

sam (Eng): Also, when opening the inline expand with Space, focus should stay inside the panel until Esc. Right now focus returns to the row.

maya (Design): Fixing that — trap focus in expand and make Esc close.

ben (Product): Add microcopy under the table: "Compact view shows more rules on small screens. Drag to reorder or use keyboard shortcuts."

elaine (A11y): Add aria-label=\"Toggle compact rules view\" and aria-pressed for the toggle. Include shortcut hints in the a11y docs.

maya (Design): I'll finalize mocks and push CSS + sam's debounce tomorrow. Thanks for the quick review! :rocket:
